name: Stewardess Momogatari
source:
Main character is an international airline pilot who has constant job problems due to female harassment at work. He is given the last chance - to train four apprentices during three months on a remote island. Protagonist can't imagine how he's going to pass three months without a woman, but luckily all four stewardess-in-training are cute girls. Special lessons begin now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
